yastay.scope: Measure one 700-tic sprite/model pair for a real guardian; no campaign or crowd budget.

iterations: Model01/02 reveal clipped ellipsoid pole loops and inconsistent winding on sharp tubes. Local sealed poles and transported tube rings fix the new shapes without changing earlier exporters. Model03 checks all then-current source components. Model04 adds original skin/fur/torso atlas, softer muzzle and rounded shoulders. Model05 repeats04 after a temporary helper path error. The first wrap-fit helper stopped before writing on a thigh-level band outside the calf range. Model06 fits all eight leg bands to actual limb triangles, maps tunic UV continuously and adds flowers. Model07 assigns upper bands to thigh articulation and narrows the collar opening. Contact probes distinguish collar/scalp support from inappropriate torso/crown targets; model08 moves floating flower hearts onto the crown. Model09/10 finalize metadata and repeat identical model08 art. Earlier failures/previews are preserved.

art.reviewed_views: Final ordinary-ambient front/side/rear, face details and inherited combat-state captures; both presentation cohorts per creature.

qualifications: Two sequential 700-tic sprite/model pairs with one visible creature and a Mandinga control. Queue intervals do not establish GPU/display timing, repeatability or campaign/crowd acceptance.
Billboard and height-fitted mesh occupy different screen areas; this is not an equal-pixel-cost comparison.
Candidate faces, anatomy, material seams, simplified hands/feet and rigid costume articulation require author review. No final-art acceptance claim.
Editable fixed-creature components are not runtime interchangeable inventory modules. Playable body/worn/first-person integration remains unfinished.
Catalogue meter ranges do not authorize runtime dimensions. Neutral art fits unchanged provisional Height; motion/lying art can exceed collision Radius.
No saved fields, actor states, scans, statistics, loot or campaign spawns changed. Both unique catalogue identities remain intact.
Closure checks cover reconstructed new source components; attachment witnesses use serialized neutral OBJ. They do not prove all-pose cloth clearance or repair older meshes.
Four selected generated textures plus rejected Yastay v1 and exact prompts retain original pixels. No development IWAD, executable, DLL, package, save or fixture WAD is committed.
